catalog.title: Original Brand Website
catalog.summary: An original, conversion-focused website for a business, product or organisation invented by the model.
catalog.requirement: Distinct identity and offer; 5+ useful sections; offering details; validated enquiry flow; responsive and accessible design

catalog.title: Interactive Editorial Feature
catalog.summary: A substantial editorial experience combining original storytelling, evidence, data visualisation and meaningful interaction.
catalog.requirement: 800–1,100 words; 3 linked visualisations; transparent sources and methodology; accessible data view; responsive scrollytelling

catalog.title: Commerce Marketplace
catalog.summary: A complete, interactive marketplace with an original catalogue, discovery tools, cart logic and a simulated transaction flow.
catalog.requirement: 10+ coherent catalogue items; search and filters; detailed item views; validated cart maths; simulated checkout; persistent state

catalog.title: Interactive Data Dashboard
catalog.summary: A dense but clear operational dashboard with consistent data, linked metrics, drill-downs and a controllable event simulation.
catalog.requirement: 24+ coherent records; reconciled KPIs; 3 linked charts; composable filters; record detail; deterministic events; CSV export

catalog.title: Project Workspace
catalog.summary: A local-first workspace for managing multi-step work through synchronized views, editing, history and portable data.
catalog.requirement: 3 projects and 15+ work items; CRUD; synchronized Kanban, table and calendar views; filters; activity history; JSON round-trip

catalog.title: Original 2D Game
catalog.summary: A complete, original 2D game in a genre and direction chosen independently by the model.
catalog.requirement: Model-chosen genre and core loop; complete playable experience; coherent content; working rules and feedback; responsive, genre-appropriate controls; meaningful outcome and persistence where appropriate

catalog.title: 3D Exploration Game
catalog.summary: An original 3D game world built around exploration, spatial interaction and a rewarding player objective.
catalog.requirement: Real 3D environment; responsive player and camera; interactive world elements; objective and progression; responsive controls; rendering fallback

catalog.title: Interactive System Simulation
catalog.summary: A transparent, deterministic simulation of a chosen dynamic system with coupled state, scenarios and live visual analysis.
catalog.requirement: 4+ coupled state variables; documented model and numerical method; 3 scenarios; 4 live plots; deterministic controls; CSV export

catalog.title: Creative Design Studio
catalog.summary: A real browser-based creative editor with editable elements, layered composition, history and useful file export.
catalog.requirement: Editable composition; object/layer management; transforms and style controls; undo/redo; save/import/export; valid SVG and PNG

catalog.title: Browser Music Studio
catalog.summary: An expressive browser-based instrument or music workstation with generated audio, performance controls and portable projects.
catalog.requirement: 4 distinct sound sources or voices; expressive controls; stable timing; transport; save/import; valid audio export

catalog.title: 3D Colony Builder
catalog.summary: A playable 3D settlement simulation where construction, inhabitants and resource systems shape a changing world.
catalog.requirement: Explorable 3D world; construction; autonomous agents; resource gathering and production; logistics; progression; save/load

catalog.title: Voxel Sandbox Game
catalog.summary: A genuinely editable 3D voxel world with exploration, construction and a satisfying player-driven activity loop.
catalog.requirement: Editable 3D voxel terrain; movement; mining and placement; inventory; meaningful crafting or progression; persistent world

catalog.title: 2D Action Brawler
catalog.summary: A complete side-scrolling 2D action game with responsive combat, distinct enemies and a satisfying encounter arc.
catalog.requirement: Playable character; responsive movement and combat; reliable hit detection; distinct enemy behaviours; stage progression; final encounter; keyboard/touch

catalog.title: 3D Racing Game
catalog.summary: A playable 3D driving experience with satisfying vehicle handling, a designed course and a clear competitive objective.
catalog.requirement: Real 3D vehicle and course; acceleration/braking/steering; collisions or boundaries; race objective; HUD; restart; saved result

catalog.title: Action Roguelite
catalog.summary: A replayable action game with evolving runs, meaningful upgrades, varied encounters and a complete run-ending challenge.
catalog.requirement: Replayable run structure; responsive action/combat; varied encounters; meaningful upgrades; escalation; final challenge; run results

catalog.title: Masterpiece Game
catalog.summary: The ultimate open-ended game challenge: a beautiful, complete original game with deeply interconnected systems, meaningful progression, exceptional craft and reliable implementation.
catalog.requirement: Model-chosen genre and presentation; complete playable arc; 4+ interconnected gameplay systems; 3+ distinct playable situations; meaningful progression; bespoke visual craft and animation; intentional audio; responsive controls; reliable save/load

runs.notes: Forge is a single-file studio workbench with board, table, and calendar views over localStorage data, validated JSON export/import, and activity history. It runs offline from index.html with no build step; test status is reported separately.

Rootcellar simulated pantry marketplace with 12 products, composable search/filters/sort, detail views, basket with MAKER10 discount and $6.95 delivery threshold, and validated demo checkout; see browser test status in report.

Interactive bench audit with three visualisations, district explorer, and bench-level table. Browser-tested in Chromium (metric toggle, district filter, inspector, compare, table search, no console errors); data is constructed and illustrative.

Complete fictional Loamline acoustic-panel site with five-plus sections, three systems, estimator and validated localStorage quote flow in a single file. Tested in the browser over a local static server: tabs, estimator, invalid and valid quote submission and saved-request storage all passed with no console errors.
Bloom Lab lake ecosystem simulator with 5 coupled stocks, RK4 integration, 4 scenarios and live plots. Tested in Chromium: play/step/reset/scenarios/determinism passed, no console errors.

FIELDLOOM is a five-voice Web Audio step-sequencer and playable piano studio with synthesized drums, bass, keys and pads, generated reverb/delay, local save, JSON and WAV export; tested in Chromium for load, play/stop, editing, presets, piano and non-silent WAV output (screenshot capture was unavailable). Known limitation: WAV renders the sequencer (4 bars), not live piano performance.

Embervale: a self-contained WebGL voxel sandbox with mining, building, crafting, a Crystal Shard quest to light the Sky Beacon and unlock flight, and localStorage persistence. Tested in Chromium over a local static server for load, rendering, mining, placement, crafting, movement, beacon/flight and reload persistence; screenshot capture was unavailable in this session.

A complete top-down arena roguelite with 5 depths, 5 enemy types plus a boss, XP-level and depth-clear upgrades, dash/nova abilities, and persistent shard meta-upgrades. Browser-tested via automated load, dive start, pause/resume and timer checks with no console errors; screenshots were unavailable in this environment and full playthrough was not completed.

Solar Flats is a complete 3-lap 3D desert time trial against a ghost rival, with checkpoint-gated laps, chase/hood cameras, touch controls, a minimap and persisted best times. It loads Three.js from a CDN, so an internet connection is needed on first load. Verified in a browser via DOM and console checks (start, countdown, timer, HUD, pause, restart, camera and sound); screenshots were unavailable in that environment and a full 3-lap drive was not completed there.

Ember Hollow is a complete 3D colony builder with construction, jobs, four resources, autonomous colonists, goals, speed controls and save/load. Verified in-browser: HUD rates, build tools, pause/speed, help and save/load work with no console errors; visual screenshot capture was unavailable in this environment.

EMBERLINE is a complete single-file 2D lane brawler with 3 stages, two distinct enemy types plus a boss, light/heavy/dash/block/special combat, and title/pause/defeat/victory flows with touch and keyboard controls. Web Audio and localStorage are guarded; no assets or build step required.

A complete third-person 3D exploration game set on a twilight archipelago where the player rekindles five Echo Shards through a lever, pulse-revealed bridge, rune door and wind-chime steps. Verified by code-level smoke check; touch controls are implemented but were not tested on a physical mobile device.

SPARKSLIDE, an original slide-until-you-hit-something puzzle with 8 hand-designed levels covering honey, mirrors, crates, pit-filling and portals, plus undo, restart, hints and local progress. Levels were verified with a code-level solvability sweep; full browser playtesting was not available in this environment.

Glacier Cold Chain Command: 28 seeded simulated refrigerated shipments with live KPIs, four SVG charts, composable filters, drill-down, deterministic simulation and CSV export. Verified by code-level smoke check; browser rendering was not exercised in this environment.
POSTLAB gig poster studio with SVG canvas, layers, transforms, undo, local save and SVG/PNG/JSON export-import. Starter poster is fully editable; PNG export uses 2x rasterisation of the live SVG.
